segments.title: The biggest scorpion EVER
segments.say: This was the biggest scorpion ever.

segments.title: Pincers over 16 cm
segments.say: Its pincers? Over sixteen centimeters long.

segments.title: Maybe 1 METRE long
segments.say: The whole body may have been a meter long. That's an estimate from fossil pieces.

segments.title: 415 million years ago
segments.say: It lived four hundred fifteen million years ago. In what's now England and Wales.

segments.title: 1871: called a giant woodlouse?!
segments.say: In eighteen seventy one, it was mistaken for a giant woodlouse-like crustacean.
